subject: Reference calls request — satellite ground operations (EU)
messages:
From: Aaron Felix <aaron.felix@satcomsys.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>
Cc: procurement@orbitalnetworks.io
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 08:14:00 +02:00
Subject: Reference request — low-latency inference for ground-station telemetry (EU)

Hi Kimberly,

We’re in the final stages of evaluating Redwood for a late-stage POC that would become our standard inference stack across Orbital Networks’ EU ground stations. Primary asks: 30–50ms per-inference tail latency, on-prem/edge deployment model in EU zones, and clear data residency + SOC2 evidence.

Procurement needs 2–3 customer references with similar satellite or telecom ground infrastructure in the next two weeks (we’re aiming to sign by end of July). Ideally we’d speak with customers who have run sustained inference on heterogeneous hardware and can confirm latency/KPIs and reliability in production. Morning CET slots are best for our engineering team.

I’ve attached the RFP and a short scope doc. Can you tell me who at Redwood I should connect with for reference calls? Happy to provide more detail if that helps with matchmaking.

Thanks,
Aaron Felix
CTO, SatCom Systems
aaron.felix@satcomsys.com

Attachment: SatCom_RFP_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>
To: Aaron Felix <aaron.felix@satcomsys.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 10:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Reference request — low-latency inference for ground-station telemetry (EU)

Hi Aaron — thanks for the RFP and the clear timeline. I’m looping in Vanessa from Advocacy and Ben from Customer Success to pull a curated set of references that match your topology and latency targets.

High level next steps:
- Vanessa to propose 2–3 candidate references with European ground/telco backgrounds and similar SLAs.
- We’ll coordinate 30-min intro calls (engineering + procurement) in CET.
- Ben will prepare the SOC2 snapshot and a brief performance extract for the models you mentioned.

I’ve included a one-page reference brief for context; Vanessa, can you share the roster and availability? Ben, once you have the SOC2 excerpt, please attach to the thread so Aaron can circulate to procurement.

Kimberly Park
Head of GTM Programs | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.example

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Aaron Felix <aaron.felix@satcomsys.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Jul 2028 09:32:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Reference request — candidate list and availability

Kimberly / Ben / Aaron — thanks, pulling candidates now. Early shortlist below (all EU-based, past work with low-latency edge inference):

1) AuroraSat (France) — Camille Dupont, Head of Ops (camille.dupont@aurorasat.fr)
   - Use case: telemetry decoding + anomaly detection at ground-station; ran Redwood Dedicated with quantized LLMs for alert generation. Reported 25–40ms p95 on A100-batched flows.

2) HeliosGround (Germany) — Markus Becker, SRE Lead (markus@heliosground.de)
   - Use case: packet loss reconstruction and telemetry enrichment; used private deployment in DE data centers with strict locality controls.

3) NorthPoint Networks (UK) — Sara Malik, Platform (sara.malik@northpoint.uk) — slightly different telco profile but strong notes on rollouts and can discuss fallback policies across regions.

I’m attaching the advocate roster with short bullets on what each reference can cover and available slots (CET). If Aaron confirms ideal days/times, I’ll reach out to schedule 30-min calls and share calendar invites.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Advocacy | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example

Vanessa — this shortlist looks great, thanks. CET mornings work for us; can we aim for the week of July 10th, any day between 09:00–11:30 CET.

Two quick asks before calls:
- Procurement needs a signed NDA before any detailed security discussion (I can send our template, or if you have a standard one we can sign).
- We also need a SOC2 type II snapshot and a short performance extract (p50/p95 for tail latency under typical batch size) ahead of the call.

I’ll ask procurement to prepare DocuSign if you can share the NDA link. Also, we’re planning a deeper on-site sandbox demo later in July if the references check out — we’ll follow up with logistics.

Cheers,
Aaron
CTO, SatCom Systems
